verses.en: The rise of the Church of Christ in these last days, being one thousand eight hundred and thirty years since the coming of our Lord and Savior Jesus Christ in the flesh, it being regularly organized and established agreeable to the laws of our country, by the will and commandments of God, in the fourth month, and on the sixth day of the month which is called April—
verses.sm: O le fana’e mai o le Ekalesia a Keriso i nei aso amuli, i le tasi afe valu selau ma le tolu sefulu tausaga talu le afio mai o lo tatou Alii ma le Faaola o Iesu Keriso i la le tino, ua faatulagaina ma faatuina aloa’ia e tusa ma tulafono a lo tatou atunuu, i le finagalo ma poloaiga a le Atua, i le masina lona fa, ma i le aso lona ono o le masina ua ta’ua o Aperila—

verses.en: Which commandments were given to Joseph Smith, Jun., who was called of God, and ordained an apostle of Jesus Christ, to be the first elder of this church;
verses.sm: O ia poloaiga na tuuina mai ia Iosefa Samita, Le Itiiti, o lē na valaauina e le Atua, ma faauuina o se aposetolo a Iesu Keriso, e avea ma toeaina muamua o lenei ekalesia;

verses.en: And to Oliver Cowdery, who was also called of God, an apostle of Jesus Christ, to be the second elder of this church, and ordained under his hand;
verses.sm: Ma ia Oliva Kaotui, o lē foi na valaauina e le Atua, ma faauuina e ia o se aposetolo a Iesu Keriso, e avea ma toeaina lona lua o lenei ekalesia;

verses.en: And this according to the grace of our Lord and Savior Jesus Christ, to whom be all glory, both now and forever. Amen.
verses.sm: Ma ua faia lenei mea e tusa ai ma le alofa tunoa o lo tatou Alii ma le Faaola o Iesu Keriso, o lē e ōu le mamalu uma, i le taimi nei atoa ma le faavavau. Amene.

verses.en: After it was truly manifested unto this first elder that he had received a remission of his sins, he was entangled again in the vanities of the world;
verses.sm: Ina ua uma ona faaali moni mai i lenei toeaina muamua ua maua e ia se faamagaloga o ana agasala, sa toe lavelavea o ia i mea lē aoga o le lalolagi;

verses.en: But after repenting, and humbling himself sincerely, through faith, God ministered unto him by an holy angel, whose countenance was as lightning, and whose garments were pure and white above all other whiteness;
verses.sm: Ae ina ua uma ona salamo, ma faalotomaualaloina o ia lava ma le faamaoni, e ala i le faatuatua, sa tali mai le Atua ia te ia e ala i se agelu paia, o lē o ona fofoga sa pei o le uilaemo, ma o ona ofu sa mama ma papae silisili atu i luga o isi mea papae uma;

verses.en: And gave unto him commandments which inspired him;
verses.sm: Ma tuu mai ia te ia poloaiga na musuia ai o ia;

verses.en: And gave him power from on high, by the means which were before prepared, to translate the Book of Mormon;
verses.sm: Ma sa tuu mai ia te ia le mana mai i luga, e ala i auala na saunia muamua, e faaliliu ai le Tusi a Mamona;

verses.en: Which contains a record of a fallen people, and the fulness of the gospel of Jesus Christ to the Gentiles and to the Jews also;
verses.sm: Lea o loo i ai se talafaamaumau e uiga i se nuu pa’ū, ma le atoatoa o le talalelei a Iesu Keriso i Nuuese ma i Iutaia foi;

w.en: to the Gentiles and also to the Jews,

verses.en: Which was given by inspiration, and is confirmed to others by the ministering of angels, and is declared unto the world by them—
verses.sm: Lea na tuu mai e ala mai i le musumusuga, ma ua faamaonia i isi i le auaunaga a agelu, ma ua alaga atu i le lalolagi e i latou—

verses.en: Proving to the world that the holy scriptures are true, and that God does inspire men and call them to his holy work in this age and generation, as well as in generations of old;
verses.sm: E faamaonia atu ai i le lalolagi ua moni tusitusiga paia, ma e musuia e le Atua tagata ma valaaulia i latou i lana galuega paia i ona po nei ma lenei tupulaga, e pei lava o tupulaga anamua;

verses.en: Thereby showing that he is the same God yesterday, today, and forever. Amen.
verses.sm: Ua faaali mai ai o ia lava o le Atua e tasi o ananafi, i le asō, ma le faavavau. Amene.

verses.en: Therefore, having so great witnesses, by them shall the world be judged, even as many as shall hereafter come to a knowledge of this work.
verses.sm: O lea, ona ua latou maua ni molimau sili faapea, o i latou o le a faamasinoina ai le lalolagi, le toatele lava lea o i latou o le a mulimuli ane o mai i se malamalama o lenei galuega.

verses.en: And those who receive it in faith, and work righteousness, shall receive a crown of eternal life;
verses.sm: Ma i latou o e e taliaina i le faatuatua, ma faia le amiotonu, o le a latou maua se palealii o le ola e faavavau;

verses.en: But those who harden their hearts in unbelief, and reject it, it shall turn to their own condemnation—
verses.sm: Ae o i latou o e e faamaaa o latou loto i le lē talitonu, ma tetee i ai, o le a liliu i lo latou lava tausalaga—

verses.en: For the Lord God has spoken it; and we, the elders of the church, have heard and bear witness to the words of the glorious Majesty on high, to whom be glory forever and ever. Amen.
verses.sm: Ona o le Alii le Atua ua fetalaia; ma o i matou, o toeaina o le ekalesia, na faalogoina ma molimauina fetalaiga a le Afioga mamalu o i luga, o lē ia i ai le mamalu e faavavau ma faavavau lava. Amene.

verses.en: By these things we know that there is a God in heaven, who is infinite and eternal, from everlasting to everlasting the same unchangeable God, the framer of heaven and earth, and all things which are in them;
verses.sm: E ala i nei mea ona matou iloa o loo i ai se Atua i le lagi, o lē ua lē gata ma faavavau, mai le tumau e faavavau i le tumau e faavavau o le Atua lava lea e tasi e lē mafeliuliuai, o lē na faia le lagi ma le lalolagi, ma mea uma o i ai;

w.en: and all things that are in them.

verses.en: And that he created man, male and female, after his own image and in his own likeness, created he them;
verses.sm: Ma o ia na foafoaina le tagata, o le tane ma le fafine, e tusa ma lona lava faatusa ma i ona lava foliga, na foafoa ai e ia i laua;

verses.en: And gave unto them commandments that they should love and serve him, the only living and true God, and that he should be the only being whom they should worship.
verses.sm: Ma sa tuu atu ia te i laua poloaiga e tatau ona laua alolofa ma auauna atu ia te ia, le Atua soifua moni e toatasi, ma ia nao ia lava le tagata o lē e tatau ona la tapuai atu i ai.

verses.en: But by the transgression of these holy laws man became sensual and devilish, and became fallen man.
verses.sm: Peitai o le soliga o nei tulafono paia na nautino ma faaletiapolo ai le tagata ma avea ai ma tagata pa’ū.

verses.en: Wherefore, the Almighty God gave his Only Begotten Son, as it is written in those scriptures which have been given of him.
verses.sm: O le mea lea, na tuuina mai ai e le Atua Malosi Aoao lona Atalii Pele e Toatasi, e pei ona tusia i tusitusiga paia na ua tuuina mai e uiga ia te ia.

verses.en: He suffered temptations but gave no heed unto them.
verses.sm: Sa mafatia o ia i faaosoosoga ae sa lē gauai atu i ai.

verses.en: He was crucified, died, and rose again the third day;
verses.sm: Sa faasatauroina o ia, maliu, ma toetu mai i le lona tolu o aso;

verses.en: And ascended into heaven, to sit down on the right hand of the Father, to reign with almighty power according to the will of the Father;
verses.sm: Ma sa afio a’e i le lagi, e afio i le aao taumatau o le Tamā, e nofotupu ma le mana malosi aoao e tusa ai ma le finagalo o le Tamā;

verses.en: That as many as would believe and be baptized in his holy name, and endure in faith to the end, should be saved—
verses.sm: Ina ia mafai ona faaolaina le toatele o i latou o e e talitonu ma papatiso i lona suafa paia, ma tumau i le faatuatua e oo i le iuga—

verses.en: Not only those who believed after he came in the meridian of time, in the flesh, but all those from the beginning, even as many as were before he came, who believed in the words of the holy prophets, who spake as they were inspired by the gift of the Holy Ghost, who truly testified of him in all things, should have eternal life,
verses.sm: E lē nao i latou o e na talitonu ina ua mavae ona afio mai o ia i le vaeluaga o taimi, i la le tino, ae o i latou uma mai le amataga, e oo lava i le toatele sa i ai ae lei afio mai o ia, o e na talitonu i upu a perofeta paia, o e na tautatala atu e pei ona sa musuia ai i latou e le meaalofa a le Agaga Paia, o e na molimau moni mai e uiga ia te ia i mea uma, e ao ona latou maua le ola e faavavau,

verses.en: As well as those who should come after, who should believe in the gifts and callings of God by the Holy Ghost, which beareth record of the Father and of the Son;
verses.sm: Faapea foi i latou o e o le a mulimuli mai, o e e talitonu i meaalofa ma valaauga a le Atua e ala i le Agaga Paia, o lē e molimau e uiga i le Tamā ma e uiga i le Alo;

verses.en: Which Father, Son, and Holy Ghost are one God, infinite and eternal, without end. Amen.
verses.sm: O le Tamā lea, ma le Alo, ma le Agaga Paia o ni Atua ua tasi, e lē gata ma faavavau, ua aunoa ma se gataaga. Amene.

verses.en: And we know that all men must repent and believe on the name of Jesus Christ, and worship the Father in his name, and endure in faith on his name to the end, or they cannot be saved in the kingdom of God.
verses.sm: Ma ua matou iloa e ao i tagata uma ona salamo ma talitonu i le suafa o Iesu Keriso, ma tapuai atu i le Tamā i lona suafa, ma tumau i le faatuatua i lona suafa e oo i le iuga, a leai e lē mafai ona faaolaina i latou i le malo o le Atua.

verses.en: And we know that justification through the grace of our Lord and Savior Jesus Christ is just and true;
verses.sm: Ma ua matou iloa, o le tauamiotonuina e ala i le alofa tunoa o lo tatou Alii ma le Faaola o Iesu Keriso ua tonu ma faamaoni;

verses.en: And we know also, that sanctification through the grace of our Lord and Savior Jesus Christ is just and true, to all those who love and serve God with all their mights, minds, and strength.
verses.sm: Ma ua matou iloa foi, o le faapaiaga e ala i le alofa tunoa o lo tatou Alii ma le Faaola o Iesu Keriso ua tonu ma moni, ia i latou uma o e e alolofa ma auauna atu i le Atua ma o latou manatu atoa, mafaufau atoa, ma le malosi atoa.

verses.en: But there is a possibility that man may fall from grace and depart from the living God;
verses.sm: Peitai ua i ai se avanoa e mafai ai ona pa’ū le tagata mai le alofa tunoa ma alu ese mai le Atua soifua;

verses.en: Therefore let the church take heed and pray always, lest they fall into temptation;
verses.sm: O lea ia faaeteete ai le ekalesia ma tatalo e lē aunoa, ne’i pa’u’ū atu i latou i faaosoosoga;

verses.en: Yea, and even let those who are sanctified take heed also.
verses.sm: Ioe, ma e oo lava ia te i latou o e ua faapaiaina ia faaeteete foi.

verses.en: And we know that these things are true and according to the revelations of John, neither adding to, nor diminishing from the prophecy of his book, the holy scriptures, or the revelations of God which shall come hereafter by the gift and power of the Holy Ghost, the voice of God, or the ministering of angels.
verses.sm: Ma ua matou iloa o nei mea ua moni ma ua tusa ma faaaliga a Ioane, ua lē faaopoopo i ai, pe ua toese mai valoaga a lana tusi, o tusitusiga paia, po o faaaliga a le Atua o le a oo mai i se taimi mulimuli e ala mai i le meaalofa ma le mana o le Agaga Paia, le siufofoga o le Atua, po o i le auaunaga a agelu.

verses.en: And the Lord God has spoken it; and honor, power and glory be rendered to his holy name, both now and ever. Amen.
verses.sm: Ma o le Alii le Atua na fetalaia; ma ia avatu le mamalu, mana ma le viiga i lona suafa paia, i le taimi nei atoa ma le faavavau. Amene.

verses.en: And again, by way of commandment to the church concerning the manner of baptism—All those who humble themselves before God, and desire to be baptized, and come forth with broken hearts and contrite spirits, and witness before the church that they have truly repented of all their sins, and are willing to take upon them the name of Jesus Christ, having a determination to serve him to the end, and truly manifest by their works that they have received of the Spirit of Christ unto the remission of their sins, shall be received by baptism into his church.
verses.sm: O lenei foi, i se poloaiga i le ekalesia e uiga i le faiga o le papatisoga— O i latou uma o e e faalotomaualaloina i latou lava i luma o le Atua, ma mananao e papatiso, ma o mai i luma ma loto momomo ma agaga salamo, ma molimau atu i luma o le ekalesia ua latou salamo moni ia latou agasala uma, ma ua loto e ave i o latou luga le suafa o Iesu Keriso, ua i ai se naunautai e auauna atu ia te ia e oo i le iuga, ma faaali moni mai ia latou galuega ua latou maua le Agaga o Keriso mo le faamagaloina o a latou agasala, ia talia i totonu o lana ekalesia e ala i le papatisoga.

verses.en: The duty of the elders, priests, teachers, deacons, and members of the church of Christ—An apostle is an elder, and it is his calling to baptize;
verses.sm: O le tiute o toeaina, ositaulaga, aoao, tiakono, ma tagata o le ekalesia a Keriso— O se aposetolo o se toeaina, ma o lona valaauga o le papatiso atu;

verses.en: And to ordain other elders, priests, teachers, and deacons;
verses.sm: Ma faauu isi toeaina, ositaulaga, aoao, ma tiakono;

verses.en: And to administer bread and wine—the emblems of the flesh and blood of Christ—
verses.sm: Ma faamanuia le areto ma le uaina— o faatusa o le tino ma le toto o Keriso—

verses.en: And to confirm those who are baptized into the church, by the laying on of hands for the baptism of fire and the Holy Ghost, according to the scriptures;
verses.sm: Ma faamauina i latou o e ua papatiso i le ekalesia, ala i le faaee atu o lima mo le papatisoga i le afi ma le Agaga Paia, e tusa ai ma tusitusiga paia;

verses.en: And to teach, expound, exhort, baptize, and watch over the church;
verses.sm: Ma aoao atu, faamalamalama atu, apoapoai atu, papatiso atu, ma leoleo le ekalesia;

verses.en: And to confirm the church by the laying on of the hands, and the giving of the Holy Ghost;
verses.sm: Ma faamauina papatisoga o tagata o le ekalesia e ala i le faaee atu o lima, ma le tuuina atu o le Agaga Paia;

verses.en: And to take the lead of all meetings.
verses.sm: Ma taitai sauniga-lotu uma.

verses.en: The elders are to conduct the meetings as they are led by the Holy Ghost, according to the commandments and revelations of God.
verses.sm: O toeaina e taitaia lotu e pei ona taitaia ai i latou e le Agaga Paia, e tusa ai ma poloaiga ma faaaliga a le Atua.

verses.en: The priest's duty is to preach, teach, expound, exhort, and baptize, and administer the sacrament,
verses.sm: O le tiute o le ositaulaga o le talai atu, aoao atu, faamalamalama atu, apoapoai atu, ma papatiso atu, ma faamanuia le faamanatuga,

verses.en: And visit the house of each member, and exhort them to pray vocally and in secret and attend to all family duties.
verses.sm: Ma asiasi atu i fale o tagata taitoatasi o le ekalesia, ma apoapoai atu ia te i latou ia tatalo faaleo ma faalilolilo ma auai atu i tiute uma faaleaiga.

verses.en: And he may also ordain other priests, teachers, and deacons.
verses.sm: Ma e mafai foi e ia ona faauu isi ositaulaga, aoao, ma tiakono.

verses.en: And he is to take the lead of meetings when there is no elder present;
verses.sm: Ma o ia e taitaia sauniga-lotu pe a leai se toeaina o auai;

verses.en: But when there is an elder present, he is only to preach, teach, expound, exhort, and baptize,
verses.sm: Ae a i ai se toeaina o auai, e nao na ia talai atu, aoao atu, faamalamalama atu, apoapoai atu, ma papatiso atu,

verses.en: And visit the house of each member, exhorting them to pray vocally and in secret and attend to all family duties.
verses.sm: Ma asiasi atu i fale o tagata taitoatasi o le ekalesia, ma apoapoai atu ia te i latou ia tatalo faaleo ma faalilolilo ma auai i tiute uma faaleaiga.

verses.en: In all these duties the priest is to assist the elder if occasion requires.
verses.sm: I nei tiute uma, e fesoasoani le ositaulaga i le toeaina pe afai e i ai se tulaga e manaomia ai.

verses.en: The teacher's duty is to watch over the church always, and be with and strengthen them;
verses.sm: O le tiute o le aoao o le leoleo lea o le ekalesia e lē aunoa, ma faatasi ma faamalosi i latou;

verses.en: And see that there is no iniquity in the church, neither hardness with each other, neither lying, backbiting, nor evil speaking;
verses.sm: Ma vaai ia leai se amioletonu i totonu o le ekalesia, po o se feitagai o le tasi i le isi, po o se pepelo, faatuaupua, po o se taufaaleaga;

verses.en: And see that the church meet together often, and also see that all the members do their duty.
verses.sm: Ma vaai ia potopoto faatasi soo le ekalesia, ma vaai foi ia fai e tagata uma o le ekalesia o latou tiute.

verses.en: And he is to take the lead of meetings in the absence of the elder or priest—
verses.sm: Ma o ia e taitaia sauniga-lotu pe a lē o i ai se toeaina po o se ositaulaga—

verses.en: And is to be assisted always, in all his duties in the church, by the deacons, if occasion requires.
verses.sm: Ma e fesoasoani i ai tiakono i taimi uma, i ona tiute uma i le ekalesia, pe afai e i ai i se tulaga e manaomia ai.

verses.en: But neither teachers nor deacons have authority to baptize, administer the sacrament, or lay on hands;
verses.sm: Peitai ua lē i ai i aoao po o tiakono le pule e papatiso atu ai, faamanuia ai le faamanatuga, pe faaee atu ai lima;

verses.en: They are, however, to warn, expound, exhort, and teach, and invite all to come unto Christ.
verses.sm: E ui i lea, latou te lapatai atu, faamalamalama atu, apoapoai atu, aoao atu, ma valaau atu i tagata uma ia o mai ia Keriso.

verses.en: Every elder, priest, teacher, or deacon is to be ordained according to the gifts and callings of God unto him; and he is to be ordained by the power of the Holy Ghost, which is in the one who ordains him.
verses.sm: O toeaina, ositaulaga, aoao, po o tiakono uma taitoatasi, ia faauuina e tusa ai ma meaalofa ma valaauga a le Atua ia te ia; ma ia faauu o ia e ala i le mana o le Agaga Paia, lea e i ai i le tagata e faauuina o ia.

verses.en: The several elders composing this church of Christ are to meet in conference once in three months, or from time to time as said conferences shall direct or appoint;
verses.sm: O toeaina ua tino i ai lenei ekalesia a Keriso, ia faapotopoto i le konafesi e faa-tasi i le tolu masina, pe mai lea taimi i lea taimi, e pei ona atofaina ma faatonuina e lenei konafesi;

verses.en: And said conferences are to do whatever church business is necessary to be done at the time.
verses.sm: Ma o ia konafesi ia faia ai soo se mataupu faale-ekalesia e tatau ona faia i lea taimi.

verses.en: The elders are to receive their licenses from other elders, by vote of the church to which they belong, or from the conferences.
verses.sm: E tatau i toeaina ona maua o latou laisene mai isi toeaina, e ala i le siilima a le aulotu ua latou auai, pe mai i konafesi.

verses.en: Each priest, teacher, or deacon, who is ordained by a priest, may take a certificate from him at the time, which certificate, when presented to an elder, shall entitle him to a license, which shall authorize him to perform the duties of his calling, or he may receive it from a conference.
verses.sm: E mafai e ositaulaga, aoao, po o tiakono taitoatasi, o se na faauuina e se ositaulaga, ona ave se tusi faamaonia mai ia te ia i lea lava taimi, le tusi faamaonia lea, a tuu atu i se toeaina, o le a agavaa ai o ia mo se laisene, lea o le a tuu atu ai ia te ia le pule e fai ai tiute o lona valaauga, pe mafai ona maua e ia lea laisene mai i se konafesi.

verses.en: No person is to be ordained to any office in this church, where there is a regularly organized branch of the same, without the vote of that church;
verses.sm: Ia leai se tagata e faauu i soo se tofi i le ekalesia lenei, i mea ua i ai se paranesi faatulagaina tatau o lea lava ekalesia, e aunoa ma le siilima a lena aulotu;

verses.en: But the presiding elders, traveling bishops, high councilors, high priests, and elders, may have the privilege of ordaining, where there is no branch of the church that a vote may be called.
verses.sm: Ae o toeaina pulefaamalumalu, epikopo femalagaai, fautua maualuga, faitaulaga sili, ma toeaina, e mafai ona latou maua le avanoa o le faauu atu, i mea e lē o i ai se paranesi o le ekalesia e mafai ona fai ai o se siigalima.

verses.en: Every president of the high priesthood (or presiding elder), bishop, high councilor, and high priest, is to be ordained by the direction of a high council or general conference.
verses.sm: O peresitene taitoatasi o le perisitua maualuga (po o le toeaina pulefaamalumalu), epikopo, fautua maualuga, ma le faitaulaga sili, ia faauu e ala i le taitaiga a se aufono maualuga, po o le konafesi aoao.

verses.en: The duty of the members after they are received by baptism—The elders or priests are to have a sufficient time to expound all things concerning the church of Christ to their understanding, previous to their partaking of the sacrament and being confirmed by the laying on of the hands of the elders, so that all things may be done in order.
verses.sm: O le tiute o tagata o le ekalesia pe a uma ona talia o i latou e ala i le papatisoga— E tatau i toeaina po o ositaulaga ona maua se taimi ua lava, e faamalamalama atu ai mea uma e uiga i le ekalesia a Keriso ina ia latou malamalama, ae lei taumamafa i latou i le faamanatuga ma faamauina o latou papatisoga e ala i le faaee o lima o toeaina, ina ia faia mea uma i le faasologa tatau ai.

verses.en: And the members shall manifest before the church, and also before the elders, by a godly walk and conversation, that they are worthy of it, that there may be works and faith agreeable to the holy scriptures—walking in holiness before the Lord.
verses.sm: Ma ia faaali atu e tagata o le ekalesia i luma o le ekalesia, ma i luma foi o toeaina, e ala i le savali ma le tautala amio-atua, ua latou agavaa i ai, ina ia mafai ona i ai o galuega ma le faatuatua e tusa ai ma tusitusiga paia— ma savavali ma le paia i luma o le Alii.

verses.en: Every member of the church of Christ having children is to bring them unto the elders before the church, who are to lay their hands upon them in the name of Jesus Christ, and bless them in his name.
verses.sm: E tatau i tagata taitoatasi o le ekalesia a Keriso ua i ai fanau, ona aumai i latou i toeaina i luma o le ekalesia, o e e tatau ona faaee o latou lima i luga o i latou i le suafa o Iesu Keriso, ma faamanuia i latou i lona suafa.

verses.en: No one can be received into the church of Christ unless he has arrived unto the years of accountability before God, and is capable of repentance.
verses.sm: E leai se tasi e mafai ona talia i le ekalesia a Keriso vagana ai ua oo o ia i tausaga agavaa e tatau ai i luma o le Atua, ma ua mafai ona salamo.

verses.en: Baptism is to be administered in the following manner unto all those who repent—
verses.sm: O le papatisoga e tatau ona faia i le ala lea o le a sosoo ai, ia i latou uma o e ua salamo—

verses.en: The person who is called of God and has authority from Jesus Christ to baptize, shall go down into the water with the person who has presented himself or herself for baptism, and shall say, calling him or her by name: Having been commissioned of Jesus Christ, I baptize you in the name of the Father, and of the Son, and of the Holy Ghost. Amen.
verses.sm: O le tagata ua valaaulia e le Atua ma ua i ai le pule mai ia Iesu Keriso e papatiso atu ai, ia o ifo i lalo i le vai faatasi ma le tagata ua tuuina mai o ia lava e papatiso, ma valaau o ia i lona igoa, ma fai atu: Ona ua tofia a’u e Iesu Keriso, ou te papatiso ia te oe i le suafa o le Tamā, ma le Alo, ma le Agaga Paia. Amene.

w.en: in the name of the Father,

verses.en: Then shall he immerse him or her in the water, and come forth again out of the water.
verses.sm: Ona ia faatofu ai lea o ia i le vai, ma toe alu a’e ai mai le vai.

verses.en: It is expedient that the church meet together often to partake of bread and wine in the remembrance of the Lord Jesus;
verses.sm: E tatau ona potopoto soo faatasi le ekalesia e taumamafa i le areto ma le uaina i le faamanatuina o le Alii o Iesu;

verses.en: And the elder or priest shall administer it; and after this manner shall he administer it—he shall kneel with the church and call upon the Father in solemn prayer, saying:
verses.sm: Ma o le toeaina po o le ositaulaga ia faamanuiaina; ma o le ala lenei ia faamanuia ai e ia— ia tootuli o ia faatasi ma le ekalesia ma valaau atu i le Tamā i le tatalo faamaoni, fai atu:

verses.en: O God, the Eternal Father, we ask thee in the name of thy Son, Jesus Christ, to bless and sanctify this bread to the souls of all those who partake of it, that they may eat in remembrance of the body of thy Son, and witness unto thee, O God, the Eternal Father, that they are willing to take upon them the name of thy Son, and always remember him and keep his commandments which he has given them; that they may always have his Spirit to be with them. Amen.
verses.sm: Le Atua e, le Tamā Faavavau, matou te ole atu ia te oe i le suafa o lou Alo, o Iesu Keriso, ia e faamanuiaina ma faapaiaina lenei areto i agaga o i latou uma o e e fetagofi i ai, ina ia latou taumamafa i le faamanatuina o le tino o lou Alo, ma molimau atu ia te oe, le Atua e, le Tamā Faavavau, latou te loto ina ave i o latou luga le suafa o lou Alo, ma manatua pea o ia ma tausi i ana poloaiga ua ia tuuina mai ia te i latou; ina ia latou maua pea lona Agaga e faatasi ma i latou. Amene.

verses.en: The manner of administering the wine—he shall take the cup also, and say:
verses.sm: O le ala e faamanuia ai le vai— ia ave foi e ia le ipu, ma fai atu:

verses.en: O God, the Eternal Father, we ask thee in the name of thy Son, Jesus Christ, to bless and sanctify this wine to the souls of all those who drink of it, that they may do it in remembrance of the blood of thy Son, which was shed for them; that they may witness unto thee, O God, the Eternal Father, that they do always remember him, that they may have his Spirit to be with them. Amen.
verses.sm: Le Atua e, le Tamā Faavavau, matou te ole atu ia te oe i le suafa o lou Alo, o Iesu Keriso, ia e faamanuiaina ma faapaiaina lenei uaina i agaga o i latou uma o e e feinu ai, ina ia latou faia i le faamanatuina o le toto o lou Alo, sa faamaligiina mo i latou; ina ia latou molimau atu ia te oe, le Atua e, le Tamā Faavavau, latou te manatua pea o ia, ina ia latou maua lona Agaga e faatasi ma i latou. Amene.

verses.en: Any member of the church of Christ transgressing, or being overtaken in a fault, shall be dealt with as the scriptures direct.
verses.sm: Soo se tasi o tagata o le ekalesia a Keriso ua solitulafono, pe maua ua faia se sese, ia faia ia te ia e pei ona faasino mai i tusitusiga paia.

verses.en: It shall be the duty of the several churches, composing the church of Christ, to send one or more of their teachers to attend the several conferences held by the elders of the church,
verses.sm: Ia fai ma tiute o aulotu eseese, ua tino ai le ekalesia a Keriso, le auina atu o se toatasi, pe sili atu o o latou aoao e auai i konafesi eseese e faia e toeaina o le ekalesia,

verses.en: With a list of the names of the several members uniting themselves with the church since the last conference; or send by the hand of some priest; so that a regular list of all the names of the whole church may be kept in a book by one of the elders, whomsoever the other elders shall appoint from time to time;
verses.sm: Faatasi ma se lisi o igoa o tagata eseese ua auai i latou lava faatasi ma le ekalesia talu mai le konafesi ua mavae; pe auina atu i le lima o se ositaulaga; ina ia mafai ona tausia o se lisi tatau ai o igoa uma o le ekalesia atoa i se tusi, e se tasi o toeaina, po o ai lava e tofia e isi toeaina mai lea taimi i lea taimi;

verses.en: And also, if any have been expelled from the church, so that their names may be blotted out of the general church record of names.
verses.sm: O lenei foi, pe afai e i ai ni isi ua faatea mai i le ekalesia, ina ia mafai ona soloia ese o latou igoa i fafo mai le talafaamaumau aoao o igoa o le ekalesia.

verses.en: All members removing from the church where they reside, if going to a church where they are not known, may take a letter certifying that they are regular members and in good standing, which certificate may be signed by any elder or priest if the member receiving the letter is personally acquainted with the elder or priest, or it may be signed by the teachers or deacons of the church.
verses.sm: O tagata uma o le ekalesia e o ese atu mai le aulotu ua latou nonofo ai, afai e o atu i se aulotu ua lē iloa ai i latou, e mafai ona latou ave o se tusi e faamaonia ai, o i latou o tagata auai ma tulelei o le ekalesia, ma e mafai ona saini lea tusi faamaonia e soo se toeaina po o se ositaulaga, pe afai o le tagata o le ekalesia e mauaina le tusi, e masani lelei ma le toeaina po o le ositaulaga, pe mafai foi ona saini e aoao po o tiakono o le ekalesia.
